Name: Multispectral / Hyperspectral Band Parameters Extension Format
Description: The BANDS extension is defined to or supplement information in the NITF image subheader where additional parametric data is required. This data extension is placed in each image subheader as required. Each Band must be identified either by the wavelength of peak response (BANDPEAK), or the wavelengths of its edges (BANDLBOUNDn, BANDUBOUNDn).
Notes: The format and descriptions of the user-defined fields of this extension are detailed in Table E-8.

ROW_SPACING.Name: Row Spacing
ROW_SPACING.Description: The row spacing is measured at the center of the image.  It is the distance in the image plane between corresponding pixels of adjacent rows measured in feet or meters.  Alternatively, row spacing can be the angular center to cetner distance (pitch) between corresponding pixels of adjacent rows measured in microradians.

ROW_SPACING_UNITS.Name: The units of ROW_SPACING
ROW_SPACING_UNITS.Description: This field describes the the units used for the ROW_SPACING field.

COL_SPACING.Name: Column Spacing
COL_SPACING.Description: The column spacing is measured at the center of the image.  It is the distance in the image plane between adjacent pixels within a row measured in feet or meters.  Alternatively, column spacing can be the angular center to center distance (pitch) between adjacent pixels within a row measured in microradians.

COL_SPACING_UNITS.Name: The units of COL_SPACING
COL_SPACING_UNITS.Description: This field describes the the units used for the COL_SPACING field.

FOCAL_LENGTH.Name: Sensor Focal Length
FOCAL_LENGTH.Description: The effective distance from the optical lens to sensor elements.  This is used when either ROW_SPACING_UNITS or COL_SPACING_UNITS indicates microradians.  The value of 999.99 indicates the focal length is not available or not applicable to this sensor.

BANDCOUNT.Name: Number of bands
BANDCOUNT.Description: The number of bands making up the image.

BANDPEAK<BANDCOUNT>.Name: Band Peak Response Wavelength
BANDPEAK<BANDCOUNT>.Description: This field must be specified unless BANDLBOUNDn and BANDUBOUNDn are specified.

BANDLBOUND<BANDCOUNT>.Name: Band Lower Wavelength Bound
BANDLBOUND<BANDCOUNT>.Description: This field describes the wavelength for the nth band at the lower 50 percent (-3db) point of the sensor spectral response.

BANDUBOUND<BANDCOUNT>.Name: Band Upper Wavelength Bound
BANDUBOUND<BANDCOUNT>.Description: This field describes the wavelength for the nth band at the higher 50 percent (-3db) point of the sensor spectral response.

BANDWIDTH<BANDCOUNT>.Name: Band Width
BANDWIDTH<BANDCOUNT>.Description: This field describes the wavelength difference between the upper and lower bounds at the 50 percent (-3db) points of the sensor spectral response.

BANDCALDRK<BANDCOUNT>.Name: Band Calibration (Dark)
BANDCALDRK<BANDCOUNT>.Description: This field describes the calibrated receive power level for the nth band that corresponds to a pixel value of 0.

BANDCALINC<BANDCOUNT>.Name: Band Calibration (Increment)
BANDCALINC<BANDCOUNT>.Description: This field describes the mean change in power level for the nth band that corresponds to an increase of 1 in pixel value.

BANDRESP<BANDCOUNT>.Name: Band Spatial Response
BANDRESP<BANDCOUNT>.Description: This field describes the nominal pixel size, expressed in microradians.

BANDASD<BANDCOUNT>.Name: Band Angular Sample Distance
BANDASD<BANDCOUNT>.Description: The pixel, center to center distance, expressed in microradians.

BANDGSD<BANDCOUNT>.Name: Band Ground Sample Distance
BANDGSD<BANDCOUNT>.Description: The average distance between adjacent pixels for the nth band.
